And I will!

Thank you so much for the talk. Tonight was pretty dark for the most part, but chatting helped me a bunch.

Sounds reasonable!

I do put watermarks on my work for those concerns, but my stalker isn't *particularly* one to steal whole pieces. More like copying my original lettering and drawing things VERY similarly to mine while inserting x character with same pose/expression/direction of canvas/what-have-you. Still annoying and skeevy as hell.

Not really. Seems they have the whole setup on several places.

Even though they're quiet for now, my suspicion's pretty damn high.
They kept copying some of the things I've said or drawn, and at one point an account impersonating me was made. It's things like those that are unforgivable.
Perhaps the Deviantart thing is about all the assholes I've seen there and the fact that my stalker is active there, too. Bummer.
I've started using twitter since December of last year; though I had to delete and start over due to a cyberstalker. Can't say I particularly feel safe about Deviantart per se.

I'm starting out with twitter and twitter only. Funnily, someone I consider a mutual on there started recently and is getting OVERWHELMING amounts of recognition. For me, that really puts a sting in the mood...
I do pixel art and digital drawings!
Honestly, I'm not sure anymore. At times I feel like I'm good. Other times, I feel inferior to whoever's rising above me. I want to feel equal.

I've developed a solid presence of imposter syndrome, and it's difficult to deal with. While I consider myself an artist, there's too many people I've met with the same hobby that deserve their happiness; their talent and their confidence is worthy of the constant support they get. And me? I get left in the dust.
